# 3 bedroom terraced house for sale

> * NO ONWARD CHAIN* Located within Yeovil Town Centre and therefore within close proximity of local shops and amenities, this beautifully presented three bedroom terraced home is full of character and ready to move straight into. Arranged over three floors, the property offers generous, light filled accommodation with high ceilings and charming original features throughout.
